text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from our outing, Dream 
Journey and I stopped by a festival that 
was taking place.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh my, isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! A bubble blower set this time?! 
I'm never gonna win that "Robo-Doggie" at 
this rate!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's right around the break-even point 
where buying it normally would be 
cheaper... Now I'm really getting fired 
up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: One more time! Let's go again!

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Guy
text_block_list.text: Here you go. Thanks for your business~

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like you two are having fun. Is 
that a raffle?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've been tryin' non-stop for a while now, 
but forget 1st prize, I ain't even hittin' 
2nd or 3rd.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I've spent a pretty penny on 
this, and having come this far, there's no 
backing down now."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Quite a few winning tickets left, 
and the grand prize is... I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good evening, shopkeeper. Those are 
quite fascinating prizes you have here.

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Guy
text_block_list.text: Hey. Care to join in?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am very interested. However, luck has 
never really been on my side.

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Guy
text_block_list.text:
I see. But it's usually guys like that who 
end up hitting the jackpot on their first 
try, you know?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Bad luck can be turned around? Heheh. 
Well then, shall we give it a try once?"

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Guy
text_block_list.text: Welcome~. Here, go ahead and draw one.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“......Here. ...Oh dear, what a pity. Out 
of luck after all, aren't we?”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"At this point, why don't we just spend 
our entire budget to buy out all the 
lottery tickets?"

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Guy
text_block_list.text: Wha-!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu! I'm only joking, shopkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, luck is not on my side. 
So, I have a proposal—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Could you mix in one winning ticket right 
in front of me? I only need one draw, and 
I'll pay triple the price.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
From what I can see, there are still 
plenty of duds remaining, so statistically 
speaking, your advantage remains unshaken, 
does it not?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Guy
text_block_list.text: ! ...Alright, deal. I accept your terms.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I saw for sure that the 1st prize ticket 
was put in! It's time for an 
all-or-nothing shot!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll draw my ticket.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Heh... right here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? You actually won first prize! 
I'm totally blown away!

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Guy
text_block_list.text: Wha, no way...!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like I win. Lady Luck is on my 
side today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And? How'd you pull that off just now? 
There's no way in hell you drew that 
purely on luck, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Judging from the prize's market value and 
the clerk's demeanor, they clearly had no 
intention of ever letting anyone win 1st 
place.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I deduced you hid it somewhere 
unpullable... such as between the seams of 
the box."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As for the rest, the results speak for 
themselves.

motive?

aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey

themselves.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I just happened to have seen a similar 
trick before, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Lotteries with no winning tickets have 
been around since time immemorial, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Just pointing it out directly would have 
been rather dull. So I decided to have a 
little fun with it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's nothing strange about 
wanting to protect one's own family, is 
there?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I knew they were enjoying the festival 
atmosphere and the raffle itself, so...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I simply thought I wanted you to go home 
smiling at the end.
